sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases water elemental attack by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases water elemental defense by 80 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 90 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Applies Water Element to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000
